info.name: Edge Delta Access Pattern Stats API

params.name: query
params.description: Edge Delta Common Query Language expression

params.name: summary
params.description: If summary true call returns up to 50 interesting clusters with 10 top anomaly, top/bottom delta, top/bottom count. Param size is ignored

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of clusters in response. For AI search, limit should be 20.

params.name: lookback
params.description: Lookback period in golang duration format. e.g. '1h'. Either provide from/to or provide lookback/to or just lookback

params.name: groupby
params.description: Comma separated fields to group by

params.name: volatility
params.description: Valatility can be new, existing, gone, all. Default is all

params.name: offset
params.description: Comma separated offsets for delta stat calculation. Each offset is in golang duration format and order of offsets determines order of offset_ fields in cluster stat response. Default value is lookback duration. e.g. '24h'.

params.name: window
params.description: Window for on demand anomaly calculation histogram series. e.g. '5m', '1h', '2d'. Combined values like '5m3s' are NOT supported.

params.name: negative
params.description: Negative param is used to get negative sentiments.

items.docs: Returns top log patterns (signatures of log messages) and their stats; count, proportion, sentiment and delta.
